To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the marginal electricity generation technology is coal-fired in the North, Northeast, and Northwest China Grids; it is nuclear-fired in the East and Central China Grids; and it is hydropower in the Southwest China and the China Southern Grids towards 2030, respectively.

the marginal electricity generation technology in China towards 2030, in the different regions, is coal-fired electricity in the North and the Northwest China Grid, nuclear electricity in the Northeast, East and Central China Grids, hydropower in the Southwest China Grid, and coal-fired electricity in China Southern Power Grid.

the marginal electricity generation technology is coal-fired in the North and the Northwest China Grid, nuclear in the Northeast, East and the Central China Grids, hydropower in the Southwest and the China Southern power grids.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and application of the marginal electricity generation technology in the Chinese power market towards 2030, based on consequential LCA.
the electricity-supply-based marginal technology in China.
the development of a consistent, scientific inventory of the electricity-supply based on regional electricity grids, and the application of the inventory in LCA studies.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, for a given region, marginal electricity generation technology is a combination of the technologies in the region and the adjacent regions.
the marginal technology in the Chinese power market towards 2030 varies with the geographical region.
the marginal electricity technology is a combination of coal-fired electricity, nuclear power, and hydropower in the Chinese national electricity supply system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the electricity generation technology in the marginal electricity generation technology is determined by the regional power grid and the electricity supply mix of each regional power grid.
the marginal electricity generation technology for China is coal-fired electricity, except in the Southwest China Grid, and the China southern Power Grid, where the marginal technology is hydropower.
marginal technology in the six Chinese regional power grids towards 2030 are coal-fired electricity in the North and the Northwest China Grid, and nuclear power in the Northeast China Grid.
The main takeaway from our work is that
marginal electricity generation technology is highly dependent on the regional power grid.
marginal electricity technology in China varies across regions.
the marginal electricity generation technology in a region is not the same as the national average.
